source_groups.evidence: Official planning-register Environmental Statement gives exact UK-PRTR-attributed Ardley EfW 2019 NOx release of 402,341 kg and identifies the facility as an industrial source.
Target-year annual report identifies facility, Viridor Waste Management Limited, permit EPR/FP3134GU, and reporting period 1 Jan-31 Dec 2019; report is required for Environment Agency annual review.
June 2019 decision independently identifies Viridor Waste Management Limited as employer for employees working at Ardley Facility.
Viridor Waste Management Limited registration number 00575069 independently confirmed.
Current public register identifies Ardley Energy Recovery Facility under Viridor Oxfordshire Limited, EPR/UP3005LJ/V003; retained only as later lifecycle context.

audits.ardley_numeric: 402,341 kg NOx is an explicit calendar-year 2019 UK-PRTR-attributed release in an official local-authority planning Environmental Statement; direct UK-PRTR raw row remains unavailable, so confidence is capped at 98.
audits.ardley_target_year_operator: 2019 annual performance report and June 2019 GOV.UK employment decision independently align Viridor Waste Management Limited with Ardley Facility in target year.
audits.ardley_permit: Annual report preserves target-year permit EPR/FP3134GU. Current 2023 EA permit EPR/UP3005LJ/V003 is lifecycle context only and is not silently substituted.
audits.bae_semantics: BAE Systems Barrow circa 33,000 tCO2e is Scope 1 plus Scope 2 carbon output, includes indirect electricity and CO2e aggregation, and is unsuitable as a direct facility air-emission mass row.
audits.selchp_provenance: Lewisham consultation appendix preserves exact figures but as a third-party consultation quotation; without direct EA/PRTR row readback it is screened rather than promoted.
audits.pdf_visual_check: Ardley Annual Performance Report PDF text was parsed. Required screenshot attempts were made and returned cache miss; failure is recorded and not treated as visual verification.
audits.registry_policy: Current official EEA/Union Registry dataset lineage remains verified, but direct raw installation-row access is unavailable; no linked EUTL row is inflated to >=99 from lineage alone.
audits.zero_policy: Missing annual values are NO_DATA, never zero.

quality.confidence_policy: 98 maximum for Ardley until direct UK-PRTR/EA raw annual release row is read; no measured promotion.
quality.scope_policy: Scope 1+2 carbon footprints, avoided emissions, consultation quotations without direct provenance, concentration compliance and pollutant mentions without values are not annual facility air-mass substitutes.
quality.target_year_policy: 2019 operator/permit identity must be preserved; later permit transfers are lifecycle context only.
quality.duplicate_policy: Repository exact searches for Ardley 402341 and Coryton 2019 returned no existing promoted row before Part79.
